text:
Ana (Design): quick thought — the test-runner page is getting dense. should we prioritize a compact list view with per-test summary rows, or keep the full side-by-side outputs?
Jon (PM): compact by default. reviewers need to triage dozens of regressions quickly. show the high-level signal, then expand for context. :stopwatch:
Sophie (Eng): side-by-side helps debugging but kills vertical density. we can do a two-line excerpt + severity pill, expand to full output with diff-highlighting on click.
Ana (Design): agree. proposal: each row shows test name, metric delta, severity pill, and a small action menu (Approve change / Request more info / Revert). expand arrow to reveal full outputs.
Ravi (a11y): accessibility checklist: expansion controls must be buttons, have aria-expanded, and announce state changes. severity pills can't rely on color alone; include visible text and aria-label.
Jon (PM): wording: `Approve change` vs `Approve suite` — we should avoid `Approve` alone. also for bulk approve: show a confirmation summary (count + test ids) before committing.
Sophie (Eng): backend note: we'll expose a bulk-approve endpoint that returns per-test statuses. UI should show partial failures inline and allow retry.
deploy-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/ux/test-runner-compact (branch: feature/compact-test-list)
Ana (Design): nice. tiny copy nit: `Request more info` feels long; maybe `Ask for info`? or `Request details`?
Jon (PM): `Request details` is fine. make the modal brief: reason + optional assignee field.
Ravi (a11y): modal must trap focus, set role=dialog, and put initial focus on reason textarea. keyboard users need to be able to submit with Enter if focus is on the textarea submit button.
Sophie (Eng): implementation estimate: compact list + expand/collapse + bulk API wiring = ~4 days. add a11y polish + tests = +1 day.
Ana (Design): visual detail: severity colors need to meet 4.5:1 contrast. current yellow for minor fails on our light bg is borderline. let's check contrast and add a 1px dark border if needed.
Ravi (a11y): yes, add text labels and ensure icon-only buttons have aria-labels. also ensure keyboard focus outlines are visible and 2px minimum.
Jon (PM): product flow question: when a test is expanded, should we pin actions to the top so reviewers don't scroll back up? feels helpful.
Sophie (Eng): we can pin a sticky action bar that appears when expanded. technical caveat: mobile view should collapse to bottom sheet.
Ana (Design): mobile: expand into full-screen drawer with prominent back button. CTA placements: primary action on the right should be `Approve change`.
Jon (PM): when a regression is flagged by diff metrics, show a tooltip with metric delta and a quick link to the reference prompt set. the tooltip must be keyboard accessible.
Ravi (a11y): tooltips should use aria-describedby and be reachable via focus. avoid relying on hover.
Ana (Design): microcopy: `Regressed` reads strong. suggestion: `Behavior changed` or `Quality change`?
Jon (PM): prefer `Behavior change` — less accusatory. add a hover explanation for non-technical reviewers.
Sophie (Eng): QA: when bulk-approving, capture audit log entry with user id, timestamp, and list of test ids. if any item fails, display inline error with retry option.
Ana (Design): ok I'll update the mock in the preview branch and push updated copy strings. leaving the severity legend expanded by default in the compact view so reviewers understand color meanings.
Jon (PM): sounds good. schedule a short sync with design + eng tomorrow 11am PT to finalize scope.
Sophie (Eng): will bring rough API contract.
Ravi (a11y): I'll pull the mock and run a quick contrast check and keyboard walkthrough.
Ana (Design): thanks team 609 — I'll post a follow-up with updated screenshots and a small checklist for the QA pass.
